description: Defines configuration properties for JWT settings in a Spring Boot application, including secret key and token expiration times.

classes.name: JwtProperties
classes.description: A configuration class that maps JWT-related properties for Spring Boot, such as secret key and token time-to-live durations.

methods.name: getAccessTtlSeconds
methods.description: Retrieves the access token time-to-live in seconds.

methods.name: setAccessTtlSeconds
methods.description: Sets the access token time-to-live in seconds.

methods.name: getRefreshTtlSeconds
methods.description: Retrieves the refresh token time-to-live in seconds.

methods.name: setRefreshTtlSeconds
methods.description: Sets the refresh token time-to-live in seconds.
